735080101.text: #Thank you for your work these past few days, Golden Comet {NICKNAME} and Silver Companion!

735080102.text: I've logged all your games, and we've been able to gather lots of data from your game records.

735080103.text: You fall under the category we call "pinnacle-class" players, and I believe that between you and normal testers, we'll be able to come up with some stable improvement directives.

735080104.text: Of course, we'd also like to hear what you thought of the game overall, and if you have any suggestions in that regard.

735080105.text: Your feedback will not only have a positive impact on Fungus Mechanicus, but will also affect the next tournament to some extent.

735080106.text: Finally, we'd like to hear about your general preferences... Would you prefer novelty, or more competitive aspects?

735080108.text: Right! Competitive clashes are really important, sure, but we'd prefer that future challenges test the bonds between us and our Fungi friends!

735080110.text: Mr. Balfour. Do you remember what I told you about the most important idea?

735080111.text: Understood! I shall endeavor to design more challenges that will test your coordination with one another, where effective communication will allow you and your Fungi friends to unleash your true potential!

735080121.text: Same as always, huh, you two...

735080122.text: Regardless, that's it for this round of Fungus Mechanicus tests.

735080113.text: Yeah! Paimon's also sure that our bonds with our shroom buddies will only become stronger, and won't weaken with time!

735080114.text: Who knows how well we'll work together the next time we compete? There's no doubt that we'll need the coolest battles to put that on display!

735080115.text: I see. So you're of a mind that suitable challenges can display the full strength of the Fungi.

735080116.text: In that case, we'll increase the number of challenging events available during the next competition!

735080118.text: That's right. No matter what happens, we'll be happy so long as we can play with our shroom buddies, clear challenges with them, and overcome difficulties together!

735080119.text: Understood. So we'd want a mix of fun and challenge, huh? It sounds simple, but might be harder to execute...

735080120.text: Leave it to me. I shall do my best to satisfy your requirements!

735089901.text: The timing's just right, and we've spent quite a bit of time testing Fungus Mechanicus, haven't we?

735089902.text: Guess we can go look for Haniyyah and Balfour right about now to give them some feedback, huh?
